finalResult.nextParagraphText: “I’m leaving in a second,” Jake said with a sigh. “I was just momentarily distracted by someone.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Jake probably also had to get going, but he was temporarily delayed as he felt something else. For the last few years, Jake had been free, but now, his stalker was back in full force as Jake felt himself being observed.
